Vladimir’s Steamboat

Tune by Jay Unger. 3rd tune in the ‘Beehive’ set on Flook’s ‘Rubai’ album.

Re: Vladimir’s Steamboat

I’m flattered that this tune appears in The Session, such a great resource and community. I love Flook’s creative and exciting version. For those interested, here’s a link to our original recording with Fiddle Fever where we have fun with the tune in three keys. Evan Stover, Matt Glaser, and I play the fiddles, Russ Barenberg is on guitar, with Molly Mason on bass. Russ and I also play twin mandolins somewhere in there. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PypsEgi9eJo
Jay Ungar
